_comment: Random-fight scouts (between waves) scale with the last wave reached. hp/damage multiply by (1 + perWave × (wave − 1)); defence is the fraction of each hit it shrugs off (capped). Count = random base + one extra per everyWaves, capped. Roles: RUNNER (fast, frail, rushes the citadel), LOOTER (half-hidden, sneaks to the citadel, steals resources and flees to a rift; killing it returns the loot), RAIDER (sizes up every establishment and attacks the weakest defence; human raiders throw torches).
